maintenance_led.reason: Sells new medical products to patients and surgeons: DUROLANE injections, Exogen bone healing, bone graft substitutes, StimRouter; first-time treatments, not upkeep.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes mainly via hospitals, physicians and commercial and government insurers; mix is not mostly government, though Medicare Advantage contracts exist.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through own product sales and development; it has recently divested wound and advanced rehabilitation businesses, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Orthobiologic injections, bone stimulators and graft substitutes have alternatives; surgeons and payers can switch, though some clinical preference exists.

notes: Payer mix and switching costs judged from general knowledge and limited website text.
